description: A University of Virginia team publishes the German SPW synthetic population under CC BY 4.0. The own Zenodo page lists an open data archive, README, contact matrix and validation figures. The README names tables for persons, households, residential locations, activity sites and activity assignments. Its source list cites the United Nations Demographic Yearbook for households, GPW for demographic totals, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places. A modeller could use these synthetic agents in national service-demand and infrastructure interruption simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this population release; German material-stock maps are a different resource. A limitation is that the SPW tables model interactions, not actual rail or road journeys, electricity loads or recorded emergency movements. The coarse version may conceal city-scale heterogeneity. No archive was downloaded and household totals or trip distributions were not recomputed.
